mechanism: A retrieval-grounded language model converts a proposed rule change into executable scenario assumptions, runs counterfactual simulations over baseline administrative or economic data, and emits variance explanations between current-state and changed-state outcomes.
transformation: Parse rule text into formal predicates, map predicates to affected records, generate counterfactual states, simulate aggregate outcomes across uncertainty intervals, and attribute deltas to specific predicates and population segments.
constraints: AI model is required for rule interpretation and assumption extraction
outputs must cite source fields used in each estimate
simulation must expose uncertainty rather than single-point certainty
formal predicates must be inspectable independently of generated prose

mechanism: A cryptographic provenance chain records each transformation applied to a document, dataset, or claim, while an AI verifier checks semantic consistency between the transformed artifact and its declared source lineage.
transformation: Hash each artifact state, append signed transformation events to an append-only ledger, compare semantic claims against source material with an AI verifier, and flag lineage breaks or unsupported assertions.
constraints: blockchain or equivalent append-only cryptographic ledger is core to tamper evidence
AI verifier is core to detecting semantic drift beyond hash integrity
private source contents can be referenced by hashes without full disclosure
all verification decisions must be reproducible from recorded inputs

mechanism: An AI-assisted optimizer translates natural-language eligibility and priority rules into a constraint model, then solves allocations under scarcity while producing explanation certificates for accepted, rejected, and borderline cases.
transformation: Extract machine-checkable constraints from rule text, validate them against records, optimize allocation under capacity limits, and generate per-case certificates linking outcomes to active constraints.
constraints: AI is required for translating rule text into candidate constraints
solver output must be deterministic for fixed constraints and inputs
infeasible or conflicting rules must be surfaced explicitly
explanations must reference formal constraints rather than free-form justification alone

mechanism: A hybrid anomaly detector combines machine-learning pattern discovery with cryptographic evidence anchoring, identifying unusual transactions or events while preserving a verifiable chain from alert back to raw evidence.
transformation: Model normal temporal, relational, and numerical patterns; score deviations; cluster related anomalies; anchor raw evidence snapshots with cryptographic hashes; and generate alert rationales tied to immutable evidence references.
constraints: AI or machine learning is core to pattern discovery and anomaly scoring
cryptographic anchoring is core to preserving evidentiary integrity
alerts must remain traceable to raw records
model updates must not alter prior evidence hashes
